The panels show 7,933 works with a recorded reference and at least one later work citing them through 23 November 2026. On each work, at least one author listed Columbia University or an institution that OpenAlex lists under it. Panel A averages each work\u2019s disruption percentile, its rank on a 0\u2013100 scale among works from the same publication year. Higher ranks indicate greater disruption. The dashed line marks 50, the middle of the rank scale. Panel B shows the median number of distinct later works citing each work. Works less likely to be sampled count more. The counts below the equally spaced team sizes are the actual numbers of works. The dotted line separates individual sizes from size ranges. For the 477 works by teams of 51\u2013100 authors, the median is 39 citing works, with a 95% confidence interval from 31 to 46 [T66]. Each bar gives a 95% confidence interval for one estimate. The intervals come from recalculating the estimates and ranks in 1,000 repeated draws within every original team-size group, including the largest.
